subject: Priv/ VPC deployment — ops primer + time windows for technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@medquick.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medquick.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-20T15:10:00Z
Subject: Priv/ VPC deployment — ops primer + time windows for technical deep-dive

Hi Jamie / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — good to hear more about MedQuick's latency targets for triage and the multi-region requirement for DR. Per our discovery, the natural next step is a focused technical deep-dive to align on the Private (VPC) architecture and ops requirements.

Proposed goals for the call (30–45m):
- Confirm network topology (VPC peering, transit, or private link options)
- IP allowlist, NAT/Egress, and firewall rules
- Data residency & KMS/keys (basic assumptions)
- Roles on the call and ownership of runbook items
- Next milestones & timeline for POC/PoC environment

Availability (all times PT) — please pick any that work and we’ll send a calendar invite:
- Wed, Jun 23: 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Thu, Jun 24: 09:00–09:45 or 15:00–15:45

Quick ops primer attached: redwood_priv_deploy_prep_checklist.pdf — it lists the minimal artifacts we’ll need (CIDR ranges, outbound IPs to allow, service account(s) for access, and suggested preliminary sizing). If you can share an internal network contact who owns firewall changes and VPC peering, that’ll help speed the meeting.

If you prefer a longer session to include your infra/software engineering team, we can extend to 60 minutes — tell me and we’ll reserve the slot.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0189

Attachment: redwood_priv_deploy_prep_checklist.pdf (1 page summary)
From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@medquick.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medquick.com>, Elena Morris <elena.m@medquick.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T02:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Priv/ VPC deployment — ops primer + time windows for technical deep-dive

Neha —

Appreciate the clear recap. Wed 23rd 10:00 PT works for Raj and me. Please go ahead and lock that slot. We’ll have Elena (network) on the call for the firewall/VPC questions.

A couple quick asks so we come prepared:
- Can you send the expected egress IP ranges that Redwood will use from the private deployment (so our firewall team can pre-check)?
- Do you have a short list of required ports/protocols besides 443 (for example, health checks/metrics ports)?

Thanks — I’ll wait for the invite.

—Jamie

From: Elena Morris <elena.m@medquick.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@medquick.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medquick.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T08:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Priv/ VPC deployment — ops primer + time windows for technical deep-dive

Thanks Jamie — looping in some context from our side.

We’ll be ready for Wed 6/23 10:00 PT. A few items from the firewall/network perspective that would make the call more efficient if Neha/Redwood can confirm ahead of time:
- Outbound IP ranges for egress (we can add to the allowlist temporarily)
- TLS/MTLS expectations for inter-service traffic (will Redwood terminate TLS or expect pod-to-pod TLS?)
- Any need for mutual auth cert rotation windows documented (we manage cert rotation windows on a quarterly cadence)
- If you are using private link endpoints vs. VPC peering — can you provide the expected DNS patterns?

Attached a short extract of our firewall standard that shows how we prefer CIDR notation and tagging on rules: medquick_firewall_snippet.txt

If you have a brief one-page runbook or check-run we can review before the call that’d be ideal — otherwise we’ll bring the network and security engineers to the deep-dive.

—Elena Morris
Network Engineering Lead
MedQuick Health
elena.m@medquick.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@medquick.com>, Elena Morris <elena.m@medquick.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medquick.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-22T17:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Priv/ VPC deployment — ops primer + time windows for technical deep-dive

Perfect — thanks for the quick replies. Wed 23rd 10:00 PT is confirmed; calendar invite sent (link below).

We’ll bring Aditya (runtime lead) and Jordan (deploy/ops) — quick pre-call deliverables from our side:
- Egress/Service IP ranges (prelim) — redwood-egress-ips: 34.82.120.0/24, 34.82.121.0/24 (we’ll provide final values before the call)
- Ports: 443 (API), 10250 (optional kube metrics; we'll mark as optional), 9300 (internal runtime telemetry; typically tunneled — discuss on call)
- TLS: Redwood terminates TLS at the edge and supports mTLS between components; we’ll bring a short slide on cert rotation cadence.

Attached: agenda_priv_vpc_deepdive.docx and updated redwood_priv_deploy_prep_checklist.pdf (includes checklist tickboxes for your reviewers).

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=medquick-deepdive-20270623
Runbook folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PrivDeployRunbooks

Looking forward — we’ll use the first 10 minutes for architecture overview, 20–25 minutes for network/firewall details, and last 10 minutes to agree on the POC next steps.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
